name: Votica
detailed_description:
The People of Velkarya Are Ready... Are You?

Inspired by real life... but made more logical.

The citizens of Velkarya are heading to the polls, and you're on your way to becoming the next president in this complex modern nation.

Votica is a turn-based election simulation game designed for political strategy enthusiasts. Filled with single-player scenarios and competitive multiplayer action, the game is shaped by clever moves, public opinion polls, and media battles.

Run for Office with Your Own Character

Velkarya will decide. Are you ready?

At the start of the game, create your own politician—your background, strengths, and weaknesses will shape your campaign journey. Once your character is ready, the 12-round election marathon begins.

Plan Your Actions, Win the Vote

Promise, forget, promise again: the golden rule of politics.

Each round, make strategic choices with limited campaign points:

  • Media & Promotion: Appear on TV shows, dominate social media.

  • Public Relations: Fire up crowds at rallies, meet voters at local markets.

  • Polling & Strategy: Analyze Velkarya’s complex demographics, identify your target audience.

  • Negative Campaigning: Expose your opponents’ weaknesses.

  • Policy & Public Image: Expand your voter base with popular policy proposals.

Every game is different, as Velkarya’s demographics—including political leanings, age distribution, media habits, education level, and economic status—are reshuffled each time. This means new challenges with every election.

Serious Satire

Lies, promises, and a bit of strategy: the road to presidency!

Votica balances the seriousness of politics with a satirical twist, reflecting the absurdities of the system. Candidates clash, media spins drama, and the public tries to make sense of it all.

Features

  • Single-player and online multiplayer modes

  • Deep strategic planning and decision-making

  • Dynamic demographic system

  • Campaign actions supported by mini-games

short_description: Votica is a election simulation game. Create your politician, run a strategic campaign, and win the votes of Velkarya’s citizens. Every election is unique thanks to randomized demographics. With both single-player and multiplayer modes, it offers a humorous yet deep political experience.
